identity: observed (R01): adult woman, copper messy bob to the jaw, long-sleeve henley with rolled sleeves, slate jeans, brown belt, worn ankle boots; arms hang close to the body, shoulders level and relaxed.

observed (live project): BP_HybridA_Player uses groom /Game/Grooms/001_Messy_Bob (matches the R01 hair mass), body SKM_MHC_Sph8_BodyMesh, face SKM_MHC_Sph8_FaceMesh, garments SKM_Sph_RetroTop + SKM_Sph_Pants70 + belt. MHC_HazelM is not the mesh on the active pawn.

authored: the fresh-start look (sleeveless top, shorts) is the at-home state; R01 clothing is the going-out look and belongs to the wardrobe stations (GR_Day_WardDoor, GR_Day_Set0-4), not to a forced default swap.
not decided from references: face details (protected), any later costume stage (shoulder cape / late equipment stays out of the start).
materials: observed (R02/R03/X01): rough plaster with patched areas, dark weathered timber, mossy shingle roof, field stone, woven wool and linen, hammered copper, worn leather.

observed (live project): plaster + dark timber veranda house, weathered boards, copper wheelbarrow, firewood; interior plaster walls, wood floor, leather sofa, stone hearth. Same family as the references; the references are rougher and more hand-built.
authored: no rebuild of the house shell from R02/X01/X02/R03; material work stays on project-owned overrides.
lighting: observed (R02): soft, overcast-like forest light with no hard sun patches, dark reflective water, warm small window accents. observed (live project, 2026-11-23): low hard sun (pitch -24) with strong shafts; the pond clips to white when the view faces the sun (A00/A02), while the west-shore view (W01) already reads dark and calm. inferred: the mismatch is the key-view direction relative to the sun, not the water material (four single-variable tests ruled out roughness, sun volumetric scattering, sun specular scale and murkiness).
camera: observed (R04): figure from head to hip, on the left third (head centre about x 0.28, y 0.25 of the frame), right two thirds open for the path and the house. authored (this pass): AC_Sph_Camera defaults OutD 165, OutDTight 135, HomeD 118, HomeDTight 98, HeadX 0.30, HeadY 0.24 chosen by matching figure scale in player-camera captures, not by deriving FOV/arm from R04. FOV values unchanged (66 out / 62 home, +3 at run).
ui: not in scope of this pass; no reference shows UI. The existing Story Framework prompts stay.
motion: observed (R05): balanced stance, walking stride with opposite arm swing, a turn with the trunk leading and a recovery/settle pose. authority limit: silhouettes only. Timing, weight transfer and camera behaviour come from the project motion work (reports sphirus-ue59-*-2026-11-2x) and real gameplay recordings.
nonnegotiables: Enclosed Woodland Refuge: depth from far bank, rising slope and tree layers; no open horizon (AGENTS.md).
Approved MetaHuman face and user edits stay untouched.
One camera owner (AC_Sph_Camera), one locomotion owner (GASP / Motion Matching on BP_HybridA_Player).
Close right-shoulder camera, character on the left, mouse look has priority, S back-pedals without turning.
Animation faults are never hidden with DOF, blur, vignette or shake.
avoid: Browser game / Three.js prototype / architecture copied from the r2g example games.
Rebuilding the house, pond or routes from a single perspective image.
Raising saturation, fog or bloom as a stand-in for lighting and material work.
Catwalk hip sway, posed-model stance, fatigue shown as dropped shoulders.
Temple / village / castle dressing in the start area.
deliberate_changes: Gameplay camera moved from the previous tighter bust framing (OutD 124, head at x 0.34 / y 0.33) to the R04 head-to-hip framing. Rollback: manifest backup of AC_Sph_Camera (see STATUS.txt).
No atmosphere or water value was changed: every tested candidate was reverted because the captures showed no improvement.
